inputs.text: Five months after a ceasefire was announced, families in Gaza are still living with airstrikes, gunfire and shelling. Ahmed Baroud, a displaced father of five in Deir al-Balah, says drones buzz overhead and naval fire threatens fishermen. Whatever the promises, a ceasefire that cannot deliver basic safety is no real peace. Civilians need order, protection and the chance to rebuild family life—not another season of fear and displacement.
